source_name: English Wikipedia explicit MediaWiki math tags

official_access.access_mode: official Wikimedia XML pages-articles dump, preferably multistream parts for parallel acquisition
official_access.listing_rule: Choose a completed enwiki dump snapshot from the official dump service, record its status metadata, download the complete selected pages-articles-multistream surface, and verify the published MD5/SHA-1 checksums before local processing. Do not scrape Wikipedia article pages individually.

structures: explicit <math>...</math> extension tags containing TeX-like math source
scope.original_representation: exact body of the explicit math tag plus the raw matched tag and attributes from revision wikitext
exclusions: Redirect pages are excluded from the default article lane
Non-main namespaces are excluded by default and can be enabled explicitly
Math-like text inside HTML comments, nowiki, pre, source, syntaxhighlight, and code regions is excluded
{{#tag:math|...}} parser-function forms are not claimed by this adapter and require a separate parser-aware lane

snapshot_policy.rule: Pin one completed Wikimedia dump generation, verify every selected dump part against the official published checksum surface, then compute a deterministic local SHA-256 inventory over the exact downloaded files. Use dump-inventory-sha256:<digest> as source_snapshot; the dump date alone is metadata, not the complete content identity.

license_policy.scope: Wikipedia text content with imported-text attribution caveat
license_policy.rule: Text contributed by rights-holders is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL, while imported text can carry compatible-license and additional-attribution requirements. Preserve page title, page/revision identifiers, stable oldid URL, and source snapshot on every occurrence. Do not mirror the raw Wikipedia dump into the Atlas Internet Archive item; publish only the permitted derived occurrence Parquets and their attribution/provenance metadata under the applicable share-alike requirements.

adapter.input: local verified pages-articles XML, XML.bz2, XML.gz file or directory of dump parts
validation: Expression body is non-empty and appears explicitly inside a rendered math extension tag
Revision/page identifiers and stable oldid URL are preserved when available
source_record_sha256 is independent of physical dump-part packaging
No reconstruction, OCR, or parser-function expansion is claimed at extracted stage
